q: On what day of the week did 3 April 1905 fall, given that 26 June 1992 was a Friday?
answer: Monday. Each common year shifts the weekday by 1 and each leap year by 2. Between 1905 and 1992 there are 65 years and 22 leap years, giving 2(22)+65 = 109 = 7×15+4 total shifts. Counting back from Friday 26 June 1992 gives Monday 26 June 1905. From 3 April to 26 June 1905 is 84 = 7×12 days, so 3 April 1905 was also a Monday. Alternative check: there are 31,861 days from 3 April 1905 to 26 June 1992, which leaves remainder 4 mod 7, so going back 4 days from Friday gives Monday.
